items.title: U.S. Steel Stocks Nucor, Steel Dynamics Rally As Canada Trade Talks Collapse
items.summary: Nucor, Steel Dynamics, Cleveland-Cliffs and Century Aluminum are likely winners from the breakdown of U.S.-Canada trade talks.  All four stocks moved higher Monday after tumbling last week on the prospect of a Canada trade deal that would lower U.S. tariffs on steel and aluminum.  Prime Minister Mark Carney vowed to retaliate "dollar for dollar," with Canadian retaliatory tariffs, starting Sept. 8.

items.title: Fresh Tariffs Boost Domestic Steel, Dent Automakers
items.summary: Trade talks between the U.S. and Canada collapsed in the 11th hour Friday, renewing fears of an all-out trade war as new tariffs went into effect over the weekend. Ford and Stellantis shares slipped Monday after President Trump announced a 50% tariff on automobiles and auto parts from Canada come January.

items.title: U.S. tariffs on Canada take effect after trade talks collapse
items.summary: Investing.com -- New 50% U.S. tariffs on about $20 billion of Canadian goods took effect Saturday after last-minute trade negotiations collapsed, prompting Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to pledge matching retaliation, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Which Steel Stock Has Dominated in 2026: Nucor, Steel Dynamics, or Worthington Steel?
items.summary: Three steel stocks sat in the same industry through the same cycle in 2026, yet their returns look nothing alike. One name left its shareholders with almost nothing while another ran away from the pack, and the reason comes down to something most investors overlook when picking inside a sector.
